# dsh-context-handoff
> Token-aware context handoff for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): summarize a long session into a self-conta
ined Markdown file, decide with measured token economics whether to continue or start fresh, and res
ume in a new session.
中文 · Publishing · Design · GitHub

- **`/handoff`** writes a handoff document that a fresh session can read directly.
- **`/handoff pla

n`** compares continuing with switching using `ctx.tokenMeter`; it makes no model call.
- **Sidebar

switch** in the right sidebar panel turns auto mode on/off per workspace.
- **Auto mode** writes the
handoff, creates a fresh session, and queues the resume prompt when an idle session crosses the thr

eshold.
- **Deterministic fallback** still produces a conservative digest when the model is unavaila

ble or fails.
- **Secret redaction** removes common API keys, tokens, and private keys before writin

g.
- **Local ledger** records each generation so `/handoff stats` can report cumulative summary cost
and projected savings.
## Why not just compact?
dsh's `/compact` replaces older history with a summary **inside the same session**. It answers: "the
context is nearly full, but I want to keep working here."
This plugin answers a different question: **when is it worth leaving the session with a high-quality
handoff?** Compaction keeps paying for its summary every turn; a handoff file is read once by a new
session and the old 100k-token history is no longer re-sent. Writing too early wastes the summary c
ost and discards useful detail; writing too late has already paid for many oversized turns. The plug
in computes where the break-even point is.
The two are not exclusive. The plugin reuses `/compact` to condense first and only writes the handof
f when the context is still over the threshold afterwards, so the cheap move happens before the expe
context is still over the threshold afterwards, so the cheap move happens before the expensive one.

## Usage
| Command | Effect |

| `/handoff` | Write a handoff and report the comparison. |
| `/handoff plan [turns]` | Analyze only

; no model call, no file. `turns` is the horizon (default `horizonTurns`). |
| `/handoff now [tokens

]` | Write now with an explicit digest budget (minimum 600). |
| `/handoff status` | Current pressur

e plus the latest file. |
| `/handoff list` | Newest files in the output directory. |
| `/handoff st

ats` | Aggregate the local JSONL ledger. |
| `/handoff auto [on\|off]` | Show or set the per-workspa

ce auto switch. |
| `/handoff help` | Help. |
### Sidebar panel
Next to the session title there is a small chip — **上下文 545k**, or **自动总结 545k** while auto mode is
on. Clicking it expands the right sidebar and opens the handoff panel, so you do not have to know wh
ere the sidebar is. You can also open it from the right sidebar's add menu: **上下文交接 / Context Handof
the sidebar is. You can also open it from the right sidebar's add menu: **上下文交接 / Context Handoff**.
- **Condensation is automatic and has no switch.** At the recommendation point the plugin condenses
once with the same backend `/compact` uses (`compactNow` from `dsh-compaction-basic`), replacing old
er history with a single summary: up to `maxCompactionsPerSession` times per session (default 3), an

d it stops early when a condense frees less than 10% of the context.
- That backend lives inside the
session's preset group (`isolate: { compaction: true }`), so a host-plane plugin cannot reach `ctx.
compaction`. The plugin therefore drives it through the official command — `ctx.commands.execute(age
nt, '/compact')` — whose handler runs inside that scope and calls the same backend. The panel's comp

action row reports which route was used: `agent`, `context`, `command`, or `none`.
- **A handoff onl
y runs when the context is still over the threshold after condensing.** That step is what the switch

controls: off means condense only, on means write the file and start a new session.
- The switch co
ntrols the new-session step of auto mode. It is stored in `.dsh/handoff/auto.json` and survives rest

arts.
- The panel shows current context, the recommendation point, a progress bar, and buttons for f

ile-only or file-plus-new-session.
- When auto mode fires, the host writes the file, creates a new r
oot session in the same workspace, and queues `Read @...` as its first message. The panel switches t
o it when the source session is the one on screen; otherwise it offers an **Open new session** butto

he source session is the one on screen; otherwise it offers an **Open new session** button.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy
Handoff files contain conversation text, paths, commands, and errors. They are written into your wor
kspace; add `.dsh/handoff/` to `.gitignore`. Redaction is best-effort, not a security boundary. The
summary call sends the conversation prefix to the configured model provider, exactly like normal cha
t. Auto mode makes background model calls and files; confirm the cost is acceptable before enabling
Auto mode makes background model calls and files; confirm the cost is acceptable before enabling it.
## Compatibility
Verified against **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3** (`dsh --version`): bundle composition, config-schema imp
ort, plugin load, `/handoff` command registration, presence of the client bundle in the Web boot gra
ph, and retrieval of the bundle from `/plugins` in a disposable Web profile. Sidebar tab/pane regist
ration is covered by the client bundle test; command execution, model calls, auto-state, new-session
creation, and ledger behavior are covered by `npm test` with stubbed services. Real summary quality
and visual rendering still depend on your dsh build and model. The plugin targets 0.2.x APIs; re-ru
n both checks after a host upgrade.
